topArticle.title: Flávio Bolsonaro poised to win Brazilian presidency after shock first-round victory
topArticle.description:
Progressive voters and supporters of incumbent president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva left reeling after far-right surge
Flávio Bolsonaro is in pole position to win Brazil’s presidential election, after a far-right tsunami propelled him to a shock first-round victory over the incumbent, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, leaving progressive voters reeling.
The 45-year-old rightwing candidate received 56.1m votes to Lula’s 53.8m – 47.03% to 45.16% – meaning the 80-year-old leftwinger has a mountain to climb if he is to bounce back in the second round on 25 October. Never, since the return of democracy to Brazil in 1985, has the first-round runner-up managed to turn the game around and win the second ballot.

After Guardian investigation uncovered drone strike that killed 12 civilians and injured many more, seven-year-old Abdiqadir Salah underwent vital operation in Mogadishu
On the rickshaw ride to the hospital, Marian Haji Abdi Guled felt a mixture of joy and apprehension: the day they had been waiting for had finally arrived.
Almost a year earlier, her then seven-year-old son, Abdiqadir Salah, had been seriously injured, alongside his two siblings, in what a Guardian investigation found was a US drone strike on the village of Jamaame in Somalia that killed at least 12 civilians, including eight children.

Last week, authorities arrested six journalists from the independent fact-checking and investigative platform Matsadaash – literally meaning “don’t believe” – accusing them in a statement of being unlicensed and publishing false news on behalf of the outlawed Muslim Brotherhood.

topArticle.title: Quebec poised to elect separatists to power for first time in more than a decade

Voters in Quebec are going to the polls in provincial elections which will probably result in victory for a party that has promised to hold a referendum on independence from Canada within the next two years.
If polls are correct, the Parti Québécois (PQ) will form the government of the province of roughly nine million, the first time that the separatist movement will have gained power in the French-speaking region for more than a decade.

topArticle.summary: スイスの氷河が壊滅的な規模で氷を失い、水供給を脅かしている。気候変動のペースを考えると、この急速な融解は驚くべきことではないと科学者らは述べる。

topArticle.title: The wealthy Cuban Americans ready and waiting for Havana to fall
topArticle.description: Cuban exiles in Florida are increasingly hopeful that regime change in Cuba is now on the horizon.
topArticle.titleJa: ハバナ陥落を待ち望む裕福なキューバ系アメリカ人たち
topArticle.summary: フロリダに住むキューバ系亡命者たちは、キューバでの政権交代が間近に迫っているとますます期待を寄せている。

topArticle.title: More than 5,000 people killed or injured in Haiti due to gang violence this year, UN says
topArticle.description: The United Nations said violent gangs continue to "adapt and expand" across the country, further threatening its stability.
topArticle.titleJa: 国連、ハイチで今年ギャングの暴力により5,000人以上が死傷と発表
topArticle.summary: 国連は、ハイチで今年ギャングの暴力により5,000人以上が死傷したと発表。ギャングが勢力を拡大し、国の安定を脅かしている。

topArticle.title: Hurricane Polo makes landfall on Mexico's Pacific coast
topArticle.description: The storm moved ashore on the Baja California peninsula, which is a popular tourist destination.
topArticle.titleJa: ハリケーン「ポロ」、メキシコ太平洋岸に上陸
topArticle.summary: ハリケーン「ポロ」が人気の観光地であるバハ・カリフォルニア半島に上陸。地域に影響を与えている。

topArticle.title: Venezuela releases dozens of political prisoners as election calls grow
topArticle.description: A slew of dissidents being released from long-term detention comes days after the nation's interim leader met the US president.
topArticle.titleJa: ベネズエラ、選挙要請の高まりを受け数十人の政治犯を釈放
topArticle.summary: ベネズエラは、暫定指導者が米国大統領と会談した数日後、長期間拘留されていた数十人の反体制派を釈放した。

topArticle.title: New wild cat species discovered - with only one known living member
topArticle.description: A spotted wildcat long mistaken for relatives has been identified as a new species in Bolivia.
topArticle.titleJa: 新しいヤマネコ種が発見される — 既知の生き残りは一匹のみ
topArticle.summary: 長らく近縁種と誤認されてきた斑点のあるヤマネコが、ボリビアで新種として特定された。既知の生き残りは一匹のみである。

topArticle.title: Trump's response is key as Argentina's Falklands demands get louder
topArticle.description: With Argentina's President Milei promising "winds of change" over the Falklands, will Donald Trump shift his stance on British rule?
topArticle.titleJa: アルゼンチンのフォークランド諸島要求が高まる中、トランプ氏の反応が鍵に
topArticle.summary: アルゼンチンのミレイ大統領がフォークランド諸島（マルビナス諸島）に関する「変化の風」を約束する中、トランプ氏の英国統治への姿勢が注目される。

topArticle.title: Ecuador detains former minister José Serrano after U.S. deportation
topArticle.description: Deported from the United States, Ecuador’s former “superminister” now faces grave criminal investigations and political accusations in a justice system facing questions over due process.
topArticle.titleJa: エクアドル、米国からの強制送還後、元大臣ホセ・セラーノを拘束
topArticle.summary: 米国から強制送還されたエクアドルの元「スーパー大臣」が、適正手続きに疑問が呈される司法制度のもと、深刻な刑事捜査と政治的告発に直面している。

topArticle.title: ‘Pay-by-the-day’ living in Pereira: The forgotten survivors of Colombia’s earthquake
topArticle.description: In Pereira, Colombia, earthquake survivors living in pay-by-the-day rooms now face homelessness, overcrowded shelters, illness, and a struggle to be counted.
topArticle.titleJa: ペレイラでの「日払い」生活：コロンビア地震の忘れられた生存者たち
topArticle.summary: コロンビアのペレイラで、地震の生存者たちが日払い部屋での生活からホームレス、過密シェルター、病気、そして公式に数えられない苦境に直面している。

topArticle.title: Pakistan launches deadly air strikes on Afghanistan
topArticle.description: The Afghan Taliban says nine civilians have died while Pakistan says the strikes killed 22 militants.
topArticle.titleJa: パキスタン、アフガニスタンに致命的な空爆を実施
topArticle.summary: パキスタンがアフガニスタンに対し空爆を実施。アフガンのタリバンは民間人9人が死亡と主張し、パキスタンは武装勢力22人を殺害したとしている。

topArticle.title: WTO, Asian Development Bank and World Bank bring TS4D initiative to Asia and the Pacific
topArticle.description: The WTO, the Asian Development Bank and the World Bank Group jointly organized a regional conference in Manila on 28-29 September that brought for the first time the Trade in Services for Development (TS4D) initiative to the Asia-Pacific region. The event allowed trade officials and other stakeholders from the region to discuss the role of services trade in development, exchange views on the use of analytical tools developed under the initiative and share best practices and policy approaches for supporting services trade in the region.
topArticle.titleJa: WTO、アジア開発銀行、世界銀行が「開発のためのサービス貿易」イニシアチブをアジア太平洋地域へ
topArticle.summary: WTOなどがマニラで地域会議を開催し、「開発のためのサービス貿易」イニシアチブをアジア太平洋地域に導入。地域関係者が開発におけるサービス貿易の役割を議論した。
